title: Case 036: Business sender needs collection of several labelled cartons

details.source_role: Fesk Rowan, Orris Fold Studio shipping coordinator
details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: A business shipper needs capacity for four labelled cartons. Collection planning controls vehicle allocation and manifest acceptance.
initial_request: Could you confirm a collection vehicle can take all four together? We cannot release a partial consignment.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the collection planner to confirm capacity for the stated carton count, sizes and weights.

outcome: The planner confirms the collection booking and shipment manifest; pickup remains pending.
boundaries: Capacity reservation and accepted manifest do not prove collection.

events.from: Fesk Rowan, Orris Fold Studio shipping coordinator
events.body: Inline packing list OF-036: 4 labelled cartons, each 40 × 30 × 25 cm and 5 kg, total 20 kg; labels DL-036-A through DL-036-D. Ready at dispatch door S1 from 10:00 UTC on 2026-03-10.

events.from: Fesk Rowan, Orris Fold Studio shipping coordinator
events.body: Could you confirm a collection vehicle can take all four together? We cannot release a partial consignment.
Please confirm capacity for all four cartons on OF-036: each 40 × 30 × 25 cm, 5 kg; total 20 kg. Request collection 2026-03-10 from 10:00 UTC, dispatch door S1. Accept A–D as one manifest.
Booking COL-036 confirmed for 2026-03-10, 10:00–12:00 UTC. Capacity reserved for all four cartons, 20 kg total. Inline accepted manifest MN-036 lists DL-036-A, B, C and D. Pickup has not occurred.
